blocks.text: A marketing plan sets out how to reach the target market, including promotional channels such as social media, television or word of mouth. Launching a new brand of Pakistani spices could mean advertising on cooking shows or working with social-media influencers who focus on traditional cuisine.

blocks.prompt: Why advertise a spice brand on a cooking show rather than a sports channel?
blocks.explanation: Cooking-show viewers are the people most likely to buy spices, so the money reaches the right audience.

items: Marketing plan: choose channels that reach your target customers.
